verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a first-party hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language, with no dashboard navigation required. It also exposes action tools such as Create-Dashboard. However, natural-language operation runs through an external AI assistant connected over MCP, and broader in-product natural-language command coverage is only implied by homepage marketing about agents. Missing for 10: a documented native in-app natural-language command interface, evidence that natural language covers the full breadth of product operations beyond querying and dashboard creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Once connected, you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
